_comment: Phase C / C/M0+C/M0.5 semantic-recall gate corpus. HAND-AUTHORED. A pair = (stored turn = a PRIOR control-IN query, later = a NEW query about the SAME topic but LEXICALLY DIFFERENT so 6-5's exact-FNV-1a-over-the-query recall CANNOT match it -- only meaning-based query-to-query matching can). SYMMETRIC use case (both sides are queries), the faithful semantic extension of 6-5's key-over-the-query match. 'distinct_positives' = topically DISTINCT stored turns (unambiguous ground truth -> the FAIR gate; ENLARGED to ~36 at C/M0.5 to shrink the N=16 error bars). 'adversarial_positives' = a near-synonym cluster where several stored turns are siblings (a DISAMBIGUATION stress test, reported SEPARATELY). HONEST: still hand-authored -> a stronger SIGNAL, not production truth; the accumulating dedicated control-IN store @21,140,000 is the eventual real set.
